title: Design System: The Interlocking Gear Animator

numeric.purpose: Every live measurement (RPM, torque, dates); tabular so digits don't dance.

title.purpose: App name in the top bar.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: The single structural shadow: floating panels, toast, hovered tray chips.

motion.name: control-response
motion.purpose: Quiet control-state transitions. The machine's rotation is the only motion that matters.

breakpoints.name: tray-bottom
breakpoints.purpose: Below this the tray rail becomes a bottom row.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default quiet action (Save, Set as drive, Saves toggle).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font: 400 0.78rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #201D19; background: #FBFAF7; border: 1px solid #B9B2A3; border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #C63D0F; color: #C63D0F; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C63D0F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Run Control
components.description: The one colored control: pause/run owns the machine's state.
components.html: <button class="ds-run" aria-pressed="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16"><path d="M8 5v14M16 5v14" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-run { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #B9B2A3; background: #FBFAF7; color: #201D19; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease-out; } .ds-run[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #C63D0F; border-color: #C63D0F; color: #fff; } .ds-run:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C63D0F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Floating Panel
components.description: Inspector / saves card: hairline-bordered, structural shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { width: 240px; background: #FBFAF7; border: 1px solid #D8D3C8; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(32,29,25,0.08), 0 4px 14px rgba(32,29,25,0.1); padding: 14px 16px; color: #201D19; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 10px; font: 600 0.9rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stat { margin: 0; font: 400 0.88rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 1px solid #D8D3C8; padding-bottom: 8px; } .ds-num { font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Drive Badge
components.description: Marks the drive gear in the inspector.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #C63D0F; color: #fff; font: 600 0.74rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.name: Slot Input
components.css: .ds-input { font: 400 0.78rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #201D19; background: #F4F2EC; border: 1px solid #D8D3C8; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6E675C; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C63D0F; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A warm paper bench under even studio light; mechanisms of quiet steel; one maker's-mark orange reserved for state. The system practices restraint as a material — hairline borders instead of heavy chrome, a single soft shadow where something genuinely lifts off the bench, and numerals treated as instruments. The machine on the canvas is the only spectacle; everything else is a tool that recedes while you work.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground with cool steel mechanisms and exactly one accent
Hairline borders carry structure; a single offset shadow carries lift
Monospaced tabular numerals for every measurement; sans chrome everywhere else
Size reads as meaning: the steel ramp darkens with tooth count (small = fast = light)
The canvas is the instrument; chrome hugs the edges

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange appears only where state lives (drive, selection, active, focus). If it decorates, it's wrong.

rules.name: The Bench Rule
rules.body: The canvas ground is only broken by hairline-bordered floating panels, prompts, and toasts.

rules.name: The Instrument Numeral Rule
rules.body: Any number that can change while watched is set in the mono tabular face.

rules.name: The Lift Rule
rules.body: A shadow means 'this floats above the bench'. Nothing else is elevated — hairlines do the structural work.

dos: Do keep exactly one accent and spend it only on state.
Do set every live number in mono tabular numerals.
Do darken steel with size — the ramp is meaning, not decoration.
Do draw chrome at the edges and let the canvas own the middle.
Do use hairlines for structure and the single shadow for lift.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color or decorative gradients.
Don't shadow anything that doesn't float above the bench.
Don't use rounded-rectangle stand-ins for mechanisms — gears are circles with true teeth.
Don't animate chrome; the machine's rotation is the page's only motion.
Don't style numbers in the proportional sans face.
